label: scam
title: Government impersonation: fake IRS agent threatening arrest

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is Officer Daniel Brooks with the Internal Revenue Service. Am I speaking with Margaret Hill?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Yes, this is Margaret. What is this about?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ma'am, our records show you owe four thousand two hundred dollars in back taxes from the last three years.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: That can't be right. My son does my taxes every year.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I understand, ma'am, but there is a warrant out for your arrest. Local police will be at your home within the hour.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: The police? Oh dear. What do I do?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You can resolve this today. You must make a payment immediately, using Bitcoin or gift cards. That is the only way to cancel the warrant.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I don't even know what Bitcoin is.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That's alright, I will stay on the line and walk you through it. Do not speak to anyone else about this case, including your son. It is confidential.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'm very scared. Can I call you back?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No ma'am. If you hang up, the warrant goes into effect automatically. Do you have your purse with you right now?
